description: Explicit ownership boundary for clean exports and updates.

categories.machinery: OS files. Updates replace or retire only files whose recorded baseline still matches; project modifications are preserved.
categories.seed: Ships to every new project, but reset to a clean starting state per seed_treatment — never copied verbatim from this repository's own accumulated content.
categories.template_dev_only: Never ships to a new project. Exists only to develop, plan, and operate the canonical template repository itself.

seed_treatments.as-is: Copy the tracked file byte-for-byte. Only valid when the tracked file is already seed-clean (no accumulated project content).
seed_treatments.empty-dir: Ship the directory containing only the files listed in `keep` (typically .gitkeep). Every other file currently tracked under this directory is implicitly template_dev_only — it does not need a separate manifest entry.
seed_treatments.empty-file: Ship a zero-byte file at this path (append-only logs).
seed_treatments.reset-template: Ship the file at `template` (under scripts/distribution/seed/) in place of the tracked path.

invariants: Closed list: a tracked path not matched by any entry above (by exact path or by directory-prefix) FAILS distribution validation instead of silently shipping.
Within an empty-dir seed directory, only files in `keep` are seed; every other tracked file there is implicitly template_dev_only without a separate entry.
Adding a new top-level tracked path requires a manifest entry in the same PR, or the repository's own distribution self-check (scripts/test/distribution-manifest.test.mjs) fails.
This manifest classifies WHAT ships. Git history and the template remote are never copied regardless of category — the scaffolder always initializes a fresh Git repository (see RC-FIX-02).
